title: MV Galv Quest Plugin: How to de-activate/hide quests?

posts.author: iClockHatchet
posts.body: Hi, first time posting here! I started using rpgmaker mv, and got Galv quest plugin for my project. I'm making a project where the player gets to do 'daily chores' as secondary quest. These chores/quest is expected to restart/reset every 24 in game hrs (which i made with variables), whether the player completes them or fails. That means I DON'T want to see the completed/failed quest log filled with the same quest showing up again and again. Is there a way to do it or should I use another plugin?

This is the information I found on that.
Steps to Hide Failed Quests:
Update the Plugin:
Make sure you are using at least Version 1.3 of
Galv's Quest Log
as it added the option to remove the failed quest category.
Open Plugin Manager:
In your RPG Maker MV project, go to the Plugin Manager.
Select Galv's Quest Log:
Find and select the Galv's Quest Log plugin.
Adjust Parameters:
Look for the plugin parameters, specifically the one that defines the "Failed" category text (it might be labeled something like "Failed Category Text" or similar).
Clear the Text:
Change the value for that parameter to be empty or just a single space ( ).
Apply Changes:
Save your project and test in-game.
By clearing the text for the failed category, the plugin will no longer display that section in the quest log, effectively removing it from the player's interface.
